rules.title: Maximum Annual General Adjustment (AGA) capped at 5%
rules.citation: Berkeley, CA Rent Ordinance (Measure BB, Nov. 2024)
rules.quote: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.summary: The maximum annual rent increase (Annual General Adjustment) for fully covered units in Berkeley is capped at 5%.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.exemption_note: Fully covered units include most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with current tenancies that began prior to 1996, and single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases.

rules.title: Minimum rental debt threshold for nonpayment eviction
rules.citation: Berkeley, CA Rent Ordinance (Measure BB, Nov. 2024)
rules.quote: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.summary: Landlords cannot evict tenants for nonpayment of rent unless the tenant owes at least one month of the HUD Fair Market Rent for a comparable unit in the Oakland-Fremont metro area.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance

rules.title: Prohibition on eviction for refusing to sign new lease
rules.citation: Berkeley, CA Rent Ordinance (Measure BB, Nov. 2024)
rules.quote: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.summary: Landlords cannot evict tenants for refusing to sign a new lease that is substantially similar to an expired lease.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance

rules.title: New requirements for eviction based on lease violations
rules.citation: Berkeley, CA Rent Ordinance (Measure BB, Nov. 2024)
rules.quote: The alleged violation must cause substantial, actual damage to the landlord. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant's behavior was unreasonable.
rules.summary: To evict a tenant for violating a material lease term, the landlord must show that the violation caused substantial actual damage and that the tenant's behavior was unreasonable.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance

rules.title: Eviction notice filing requirement with Rent Board
rules.citation: Berkeley, CA Rent Ordinance (Measure BB, Nov. 2024)
rules.quote: The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.
rules.summary: Landlords must file copies of eviction notices and eviction lawsuits with the Rent Board within three business days of serving the tenant.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance

rules.title: Mandatory annual adjustment of owner move-in relocation assistance
rules.citation: Berkeley, CA Rent Ordinance (Measure BB, Nov. 2024)
rules.quote: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.summary: The Rent Board is required to adjust owner move-in eviction relocation assistance payments annually for inflation.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
